errors.text_span: The largest segment, colored green, represents "Good is integrated" and constitutes 25% of the chart
errors.evidence: The green segment correctly represents 25% but is labeled "Добре е интегриран" (Good is integrated), not "Good is integrated" in English. The description misaligns the label translation.

errors.text_span: The second largest, in purple, is "Somewhat good is integrated" at 24%
errors.evidence: The purple segment represents "Не е интегриран такъв подход" (Not integrated such an approach) and accounts for 20%, not 24%. The 24% segment is orange and labeled "Много добре е интегриран" (Very well integrated).

errors.text_span: The blue segment, "Not integrated at all," accounts for 20%
errors.evidence: The blue segment represents "Изцяло е интегриран" (Fully integrated) and accounts for 10%, not 20%. The 20% segment is purple and labeled "Не е интегриран такъв подход" (Not integrated such an approach).

errors.text_span: the smallest segment, in orange, represents "Not integrated at all" with 10%
errors.evidence: The orange segment represents "Много добре е интегриран" (Very well integrated) and accounts for 24%, not 10%. The 10% segment is blue and labeled "Изцяло е интегриран" (Fully integrated).

errors.text_span: The red segment, "Not integrated," makes up 8%
errors.evidence: The red segment is correctly labeled as 8% but the label is "Слабо е интегриран" (Poorly integrated), not "Not integrated".
The description omits the presence of a legend and percentage labels inside the slices, which are visible in the figure.

errors.text_span: The chart does not include a legend, percentage labels inside the slices, or any visual emphasis on specific slices
errors.evidence: The figure includes a legend and percentage labels inside the slices, contrary to the description's claim.

errors.text_span: The pie chart represents the integration of design in the product development process within an organization
errors.evidence: The description does not explicitly state the chart represents the *degree of agreement* with the statement about design integration, as specified in the reference.
